summary: Create a key/value secret (for example chatbot-configuration-secret) in the AAP namespace with chatbot_model, chatbot_url (Azure: .../openai/v1), chatbot_token, optional chatbot_llm_provider_type (rhelai_vllm, rhoai_vllm, openai, azure_openai) and chatbot_model_config_extras.
questions: How do I create the chatbot configuration secret?
What keys does the Lightspeed chatbot secret need?
What chatbot_url should I use for Azure OpenAI?

answer_card.title: Chatbot configuration secret
answer_card.answer_md:
Workloads > Secrets > Create > Key/value secret in the AAP namespace:
- `chatbot_model`: model name
- `chatbot_url`: e.g. `https://your_inference_api/v1` (Azure: `.../openai/v1`)
- `chatbot_token`: API key
- `chatbot_llm_provider_type` (optional): `rhelai_vllm`, `rhoai_vllm`, `openai`, `azure_openai`
- `chatbot_model_config_extras` (optional JSON), e.g. `'{"api_version": "..."}'` for Azure
